Most veterans don’t realize this: VA disability ratings don’t use normal math.

50% + 30% does NOT equal 80%.
It equals 65%… which rounds to 70%.

That difference impacts your compensation. It impacts your family. It impacts your future.

The system isn’t broken.
It’s just not explained clearly.
